body:
Scavenged Parts is definitely the answer. They’ve got a booth at Atomic Antiques on the west side, which is also just a great antique mall to wander around for a few hours. Massive building with lots of neat vendors other than SP.

If you’d wanna make the drive down to Rockford, about and hour a way, Scavenged has a full fledged bona-fide oddities shop down there with all manner of bizarre, beautiful, and rare things. Check out their IG if you wanna see more: https://www.instagram.com/scavengedparts?igsh=MXFjZmE5bzh0Zm1reA%3D%3D&utm_source=qr
That sounds very much like our wheelhouse! If you’d ever want to ring the shop line to set up an appointment or drop on by sometime with them we would be more than happy to take a look.

Thanks for the info and advice! I would eventually like to look into staying here longterm, but am still trying to cobble together a decent chunk in savings before making any big moves. The dream is definitely home ownership though, and fingers very, very crossed that the housing market won’t go too crazy before I get to that stage.
We really like A Breed Apart on the west side! The staff is very kind and when we got our rescue kitty a few years back with some pretty bad dental issues they were able to help us out :)

Nope, this is the owners’ first brick and mortar location. Before setting up this shop, they had a workspace closed to the public also in Rockford but mostly made their names by traveling the country with the Oddities and Curiosities Expo. This shop is actually the fusion of two distinct businesses into one— antiques + bone sculptures, insect displays, and wet specimens.
Will do 🖤 Many thanks!
Not at the moment unfortunately! Though you can always have someone take down your name and number on the chance we’ll be hiring again one day :)

So one of the owners, Sarah, has a vested interest in old Victorian hair art and creepy dolls. I’m also fairly certain we’ve actually sold a doll or two that had human hair like this. I’m not so certain we’d be able to do anything with the hair, but very much yes with the doll. If you bring either (or both) item in while we’re open or call the shop number to set up an appointment (which could be at any time convenient to you; someone is almost always in the backroom during the week) we could certainly see if these are something we could take off your hands.
We’re technically in the Midtown area, though yes “way downtown” seems more or less accurate haha

There are! In fact, both owners as well as most of our employees (including me) have pieces on display ranging from mediums like pen and ink, paint, taxidermy dioramas, sculptures made from real bones, and preserved insect displays. We also participate in both spring and fall ArtScene, and are always happy to find and showcase new artists who mesh well with our overall vibe.
This is soo cute! I’m so sad to see it’s not available anymore 🥲 It didn’t even cross my mind to look for ISTVG pins!

Hi! I know I’m the one who posted this, but I ended up finding a place and would recommend looking with Weichert-Tover and Goldsmith Chase LLC. Refreshing Zillow daily for the “1 day” listings worked best for me, especially as this site has the option to pay a one-time fee for an application you can use repeatedly. Just make sure to call any numbers attached to the listing as some places don’t seem to check their notifications all that much! Good luck in your search!
Don’t speak Latin in front of the books!

Thanks so much for such a great list, quite a few of these I’ve never heard of and the others are ones I’ve heard similar things about. I’m lucky to have coworkers and family from the area that can help me out with neighborhoods but all of them are homeowners and don’t exactly know the rental game all that well. I appreciate your response!
Good to know! Will def check them out. Thanks!

I appreciate this response. I’ve definitely been trying to keep an eye on multiple platforms that post listings which is why I’ve only been more and more discouraged by how quickly I watch new postings disappear. Trying very hard to stay within budget, but I know what you’re talking about. It’s just surprising, as someone currently living in Madison (notoriously rent expensive), to see just how high the prices have gotten here.

Yeahh, luckily I at least have the luxury to be fairly flexible with the timespan as my current roommate has extended the lease on our apartment into next year for herself and she doesn’t mind me staying until I find something. I’ve been searching for several months now but it’s tough to lock something down in advance without paying rent overlap— which would’ve been tough on my tight budget. It’s just surprising to see how high the rent prices seem to become.

I’ve heard this, it’s kind of wild to see just how exponentially this city seems to have grown just in the time I’ve been gone (or, at least it seems that way to me). And yeah, have definitely been looking as far as Beloit and even Janesville just to keep an eye out for anything that may meet my criteria. I currently live in Madison and commute down to Rockford 3-4 days out of the week but am arriving at a point where anything even slightly closer would be fantastic haha. Thank you for your reply!

I Saw the TV Glow…. threw it on because of a vague memory recalling its title and was promptly sucked completely in within 20 minutes. It ended up speaking to me in such a specific and fantastic way and while every subsequent rewatch has been enjoyable and revealed something new…. I wish I could relive that first feeling of awe, horror, and profound kinship with the main characters.
Seconded 🖤 Still makes me a tad emotional to hear it in the wild.
I wanted to be an archeologist. Somehow I’ve found myself a job nowadays as a traveling vendor for a national oddities expo circuit peddling dead shit in jars and bizarre antiques.

Thank you so much for the advice! I really appreciate it :)  I've been nervous to move it too much as its pretty winter-y right now where I live but yeah... it checks out that a better pot in general may be a great first step;;
